lines.latin: Credo in unum Deum,
lines.english: I believe in one God,

lines.latin: Patrem omnipoténtem, factórem cæli et terræ,
lines.english: the Father almighty, Maker of heaven and earth,

lines.latin: visibílium ómnium, et invisibílium.
lines.english: and of all things visible and invisible.

lines.latin: Et in unum Dóminum Jesum Christum,
lines.english: And in one Lord Jesus Christ,

lines.latin: Fílium Dei unigénitum.
lines.english: the only-begotten Son of God,

lines.latin: Et ex Patre natum ante ómnia sǽcula.
lines.english: born of the Father before all ages;

lines.latin: Deum de Deo, lumen de lúmine, Deum verum de Deo vero.
lines.english: God of God, Light of Light, true God of true God;

lines.latin: Génitum, non factum, consubstantiálem Patri:
lines.english: begotten, not made; of one substance with the Father;

lines.latin: per quem ómnia facta sunt.
lines.english: by whom all things were made.

lines.latin: Qui propter nos hómines, et propter nostram salútem descéndit de cælis.
lines.english: Who for us men and for our salvation came down from heaven.

lines.latin: Et incarnátus est de Spíritu Sancto ex María Vírgine:
lines.english: And became incarnate by the Holy Ghost of the Virgin Mary:

lines.latin: Et homo factus est.
lines.english: and was made man.

lines.latin: Crucifíxus étiam pro nobis: sub Póntio Piláto passus, et sepúltus est.
lines.english: He was crucified also for us, suffered under Pontius Pilate, and was buried.

lines.latin: Et resurréxit tértia die, secúndum Scriptúras.
lines.english: And the third day He rose again according to the Scriptures.

lines.latin: Et ascéndit in cælum: sedet ad déxteram Patris.
lines.english: And He ascended into heaven, and sitteth at the right hand of the Father.

lines.latin: Et íterum ventúrus est cum glória, judicáre vivos et mórtuos:
lines.english: And He shall come again with glory to judge the living and the dead;

lines.latin: cujus regni non erit finis.
lines.english: of whose kingdom there shall be no end.

lines.latin: Et in Spíritum Sanctum, Dóminum, et vivificántem:
lines.english: And in the Holy Ghost, the Lord and Giver of life,

lines.latin: qui ex Patre Filióque procédit.
lines.english: who proceedeth from the Father and the Son;

lines.latin: Qui cum Patre et Fílio simul adorátur, et conglorificátur:
lines.english: who together with the Father and the Son is adored and glorified;

lines.latin: qui locútus est per Prophétas.
lines.english: who spoke by the Prophets.

lines.latin: Et unam, sanctam, cathólicam et apostólicam Ecclésiam.
lines.english: And one holy, catholic and apostolic Church.

lines.latin: Confíteor unum baptísma in remissiónem peccatórum.
lines.english: I confess one baptism for the remission of sins.

lines.latin: Et exspécto resurrectiónem mortuórum.
lines.english: And I look for the resurrection of the dead,

lines.latin: Et vitam ventúri sǽculi. Amen.
lines.english: and the life of the world to come. Amen.

note: English: the app's own Nicene Creed (PrayerBookFoundations.swift, nicene_creed), split at the chant's phrases
